_comment: Merge into <your project>/.claude/settings.json. Replace PATH/TO/phantom-packages with the absolute path of your clone (forward slashes work on Windows). Verified 2026-10-30 against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks: PreToolUse gets JSON on stdin (tool_name; tool_input.command for Bash and PowerShell); 'Bash|PowerShell' is an exact-name list; exit 2 blocks the call and stderr goes to Claude. Optional env: PHANTOM_OFFLINE=1 (no PyPI, TabPFN estimate only), PHANTOM_FAIL_CLOSED=1 (block when PyPI or the guard fails).
